description: Reviewed exceptions to the plain rule (an LHA belongs to a region when at least half of it lies inside the georectified printed region). Every other region uses that rule directly; see public/health-geography/georectification.json for each region's LHA shares.

areas.note: New Westminster is too small to resolve on the 1997/98 inset. The 2001 boundary schedule for this region names Burnaby and New Westminster, and the Statistics Canada map places New Westminster in Simon Fraser.

The Southern Gulf Islands are shaded but unnumbered in the inset. The 2001 boundary schedule runs Capital's edge along Houstoun Passage and Stuart Channel, which places Salt Spring and the southern Gulf Islands inside it.
